# specification-service

> Composes characteristics into specs; cache synced via subscribed events.

- [Overview](wiki/overview.md): Event consumer, local cache, outbox emissions, endpoints, tests.

- Domain: `services/specification-service/src/domain/models.py`
- Tests: `services/specification-service/tests/`
